neighbours.label: ' index' in 'body mass index' (also 'Body Mass Index (BMI)' and the number after 'BMI'); other indexes (price index, a book's index) stay quiet
fire: Nurses calculate the body mass index from a patient's height and weight.
A body mass index below 18.5 is considered underweight.
The study grouped children by body mass index and age.
Body Mass Index (BMI) is a rough guide to a healthy weight.
Athletes often have a high body mass index despite having little fat.
Insurers sometimes ask for your body mass index before quoting a premium.
Her body mass index fell from 33 to 27 over the year.
Critics say the body mass index ignores where fat is stored.
quiet: Nurses calculate the correct dose from a patient's height and weight.
A glycemic index below 55 is considered low.
The study grouped countries by human development index and region.
The Dow Jones Index (DJI) is a rough guide to the stock market.
Athletes often have a high resting metabolism despite eating little fat.
Insurers sometimes ask for your credit score before quoting a premium.
Her body weight fell from 90 to 75 kilos over the year.
Critics say the retail price index ignores the cost of housing.

notes: Card: ' index'/' Index' after 'body mass', ' BMI', and digits of a BMI value. Probes: 'body mass index' 1.01 and 0.73, 'BMI was 31' 0.48; 'consumer price index' 0.01, 'the index at the back of the book' 0.01, 'body weight' 0.18. The opposite pole fires on ' waist' (waistline, waist circumference): a rival body measure.
